title: Farm AutoClicker
description: This mod is an easy to use Farm AutoClicker
body:
The AutoClicker only works for armor stands, so there's no need to worry about PVP cheating etc.

**Download insctructions:**


1. Download the version that matches your Minecraft server version.
2. Put the jar file into your plugins folder in your minecraft server files.
3. Restart your server.

**To ENABLE the AutoClicker**

/autoclick PLAYER_NAME

**To DISABLE the AutoClicker**

/autoclick PLAYER_NAME


**NOTE: The AutoClicker only clicks when you are near an armor stand.**
